Conclusion
A shift to diagnosing high-risk individuals for diabetes or prediabetes even earlier than current screening modalities enables the
opportunity for reducing progression to diabetes and its associated complications. However, the currently available diagnostic tests,
as the FPG, 2 h PG, and HbA1c, have performance limitations and are inadequate to classify high-risk individuals owing to the
multi-factorial nature of the diseases. Integrating our knowledge of genomics, immunology, and metabolic data will improve
